configurePresets.name: sanitize-debug
configurePresets.description: Debug build with ENABLE_SANITIZERS=ON. Catches out-of-bounds/undefined-behavior bugs in the hand-rolled pointer/array indexing in the EKF and Jacobi eigensolver. UBSan only applies on non-MSVC compilers (Clang/GCC); MSVC gets AddressSanitizer alone.
